title: Installation
subtitle: Get started with @qortex/store-react
description: Install @qortex/store-react for React state management with selectors.
content: Install @qortex/store-react using your preferred package manager. It includes @qortex/store as a dependency automatically.

sections.title: Install Package
sections.content: @qortex/store is included as a dependency — you only need to install @qortex/store-react:

code.code:
# npm
npm install @qortex/store-react

# yarn
yarn add @qortex/store-react

# pnpm
pnpm add @qortex/store-react

sections.title: Requirements
sections.content:
• **@qortex/store** — Included as a dependency (auto-installed)
• **React** ≥ 18 — Required as peer dependency
